rules: On CREATE (POST): execution_generation = high_water(project, artifact_id) + 1. First creation => 1.
On UPDATE (PUT) with a changed ArtifactExecutionProjectionV1 digest: increment execution_generation exactly once and store the new digest.
On UPDATE (PUT) with an unchanged digest (semantic no-op): execution_generation and digest are unchanged.
On DELETE: remove the artifact but retain high_water(project, artifact_id) (DC-1).
Authorization binds {service_id, artifact_id, execution_generation, execution_projection_digest} and execution_pinning_mode.
Authorization is valid only if BOTH execution_generation AND execution_projection_digest equal the current artifact values, and the delivered artifact_id matches.
No resurrection: reverting content to an earlier digest never re-validates an authorization bound to an earlier generation, because the generation has moved on.
Server-owned: client-supplied execution_generation / execution_projection_digest are rejected unless equal to current (DC-5).
Safety never depends on writing to the authorization domain on an artifact change; invalidation is derived at use time by comparison.
Execution-time validity (an artifact change between context fetch and mutation start) is TD-1 / ADR-0012 and is NOT decided here.
